Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Lalit Samant, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. J.C. Pandey, learned Standing Counsel for the
State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Saurabh Adhikari, learned Standing Counsel for 
the Union of India/ respondent no.3.
4. Respondent no.2 has provided written instructions 
through the Chief Standing Counsel and the same are 
taken on record.
5. As the matter involves supply of sub-standard 
medicines by the petitioner firm, we would also like to 
know from the State-respondents if any action has been 
taken by them for setting in motion the criminal machinery. 
6. List this case as fresh on 30.04.2026.
7. Respondent no.2 will file his affidavit on all aspects 
positively by the next date.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
